property_summary: After initializing C, calling transferOwnership(address(0)) on the buggy version (without zero-address check) succeeds silently, while on the reference version it reverts; then calling transferOwnership(owner) with the zero address as owner reverts on the buggy version because owner() == address(0) and the caller is not the owner, but on the reference version the owner is unchanged so the call succeeds -- the divergence is that on the buggy version the contract ownership is effectively lost and the onlyProgramOperator modifier cannot be bypassed, while on the reference version the original owner retains control.
change_summary: Remove the require check for zero address so transferOwnership will succeed with zero address without error.
